integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> rests one hand on the iron rail of a staircase, framed from the waist up in a quiet dim room. The camera pushes in at slow speed. When <Subject 1> tries to lift the hand, the fingers do not come away: at the point of contact the skin has already become cold black iron, flowing seamlessly into the object with no line where one ends and the other begins. <Subject 1> pulls gently, then harder; the joined surface stretches slightly and holds. The change spreads a few centimetres up the wrist in a clean even edge, the skin turning into cold black iron as it passes. <Subject 1> stares at the hand, now visibly part of the iron rail of a staircase, and presses the free hand against the boundary. In the final moment <Subject 1> lets go with the other hand, and the fingers of the fused hand move under the surface of the object.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, strained breathing, a low ringing of iron, and a slow tension as the hand pulls.
